learning: Nine iterations show a sharp local optimum at the baseline. Any single-lever change so far has collapsed or cut the oval. Bend limits have stayed near progress 0.17 (s-bend) and 0.12 (slalom) with max_error about 0.061 m, which suggests a controller-side or deeper limit.
notes: Exact reproduction of the iteration-0 baseline geometry and controller, as requested by the Builder. The controller is unchanged so that the only comparison is against the 356.6 reference. Per-bend progress and lateral error at first line loss will be reported from the race.
rationale: Iteration 0 is the only design that finishes any track (oval 20/20 at 1.65 s, score 356.6). Every later single or combined change has cut oval finishes or collapsed the oval to 0/20: sensor y at 0.03 and 0.07, footprints of 8 and 16 mm, spread to ±0.032 m, body length 0.12 m, and the 0.5 kg / 0.10 m track / 0.033 m radius drivetrain. The Builder's entity0 asks for an exact reproduction of iteration 0, so I keep the geometry and the iteration-0 controller unchanged (kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.8, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], last_direction). Changing the controller here would confound the platform check. The race is a stability check: if the oval returns 20/20 near 1.65 s, the platform is repeatable. The measurements requested cover the per-bend progress and lateral error at first line loss, so the bend limit can be diagnosed. I expect a score near 356, but this is untested and no bend completion is expected.
